extracted.intended_audience: food journalists / restaurant critics / newsroom editors
extracted.subtask_description: Standards and criteria for conducting, evaluating, and publishing restaurant reviews and broader food-beat journalism, including process, evaluation dimensions, newsworthiness, star systems, and ethics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Anonymity
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviews conducted anonymously when possible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make reservations under a non-reviewer name; pay with non-identifying methods; avoid being recognized by staff to ensure authentic service and experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple Visits
rubrics_metrics.description: Two visits recommended; three preferred.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Visit on different days and at different times because service, food, and atmosphere can vary day-to-day; corroborate impressions across visits before publishing evaluative judgments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive Tasting
rubrics_metrics.description: Full range of menu (apps to desserts) should be sampled.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Taste everything ordered; at minimum, every item mentioned in the column should have been tasted by the reviewer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Michelin star meanings
rubrics_metrics.description: Michelin: ★ — 'Very good restaurant'; ★★ — 'Worth a detour'; ★★★ — 'Exceptional cuisine, worth a special journey'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Michelin's succinct tiered language to convey relative dining experience; understand that Michelin focuses heavily on cuisine and technique.

rubrics_metrics.name: Newspaper star systems
rubrics_metrics.description: 0-4 stars typically used by major newspapers (e.g., NYT, WaPo).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These ratings commonly combine evaluations of food, service, atmosphere, and value into a single star score; be explicit about what factors influenced the star count in the text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Food quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Flavor, technique, ingredients.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess taste, cooking skill/technique, ingredient quality and provenance; give concrete examples of standout or problematic dishes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Menu
rubrics_metrics.description: Coherence, originality, range.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate whether the menu makes sense as a whole, shows creativity, and offers appropriate variety for concept and audience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Service
rubrics_metrics.description: Professionalism, warmth, knowledge.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report on staff competence, friendliness, speed, and knowledge about dishes and ingredients; note service consistency across visits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Atmosphere
rubrics_metrics.description: Ambiance, design, comfort.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the dining room, noise level, décor, seating comfort, and how ambiance aligns with the restaurant's concept.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value
rubrics_metrics.description: Quality relative to cost.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider portion sizes, pricing, experience, and whether the meal offers appropriate value for the price point; explicate assumptions (e.g., neighborhood, cuisine type).

rubrics_metrics.name: Concept
rubrics_metrics.description: Restaurant's vision and execution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess clarity and originality of concept and whether the food, service, and design coherently realize that concept.

rubrics_metrics.name: Execution
rubrics_metrics.description: Consistency, plating, timing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate how well dishes are prepared and presented, whether timing between courses is appropriate, and whether the kitchen shows consistency across visits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Beverage program
rubrics_metrics.description: Wine, cocktails, non-alcoholic offerings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judge selection, quality, pairing suitability, and service knowledge for alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cultural significance
rubrics_metrics.description: What the restaurant represents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider the restaurant's role in representing a cuisine, community, cultural moment, or contribution to the local dining landscape.

rubrics_metrics.name: Major opening of an acclaimed chef
rubrics_metrics.description: Newsworthiness criterion: major opening of acclaimed chef.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High-profile chef debuts are priority review targets due to public interest and perceived impact on dining scene.

rubrics_metrics.name: High anticipation based on pedigree
rubrics_metrics.description: Newsworthiness criterion: restaurants with high anticipation because of chef/owner pedigree.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pre-opening pedigree (restaurant groups, notable sous chefs, prior accolades) makes a new place a candidate for review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hot trend representation
rubrics_metrics.description: Newsworthiness criterion: restaurants that exemplify a current hot trend.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If an opening embodies an emerging trend, it merits coverage to inform readers about broader patterns in dining.

rubrics_metrics.name: Major reopening after revamp
rubrics_metrics.description: Newsworthiness criterion: major reopening after significant renovation or revamp.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Substantive changes to a previously covered restaurant (menu overhaul, new chef, redesign) justify a fresh review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethnic cuisine newly visible
rubrics_metrics.description: Newsworthiness criterion: ethnic cuisine gaining visibility in the market.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New or previously undercovered ethnic cuisines that increase cultural diversity in the food scene are review-worthy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Underrecognized neighborhood standout
rubrics_metrics.description: Newsworthiness criterion: standout restaurants in underrecognized neighborhoods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlighting strong restaurants outside core dining districts serves readers and shines light on changing neighborhood dynamics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Closing announcement — final review
rubrics_metrics.description: Newsworthiness criterion: impending closure that warrants a final review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A restaurant's announced closing can be an occasion for a final evaluation and retrospective on its impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award attention
rubrics_metrics.description: Newsworthiness criterion: restaurants receiving awards (James Beard, Michelin).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awards generate reader interest and may trigger reviews or follow-up coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restaurant publishing a cookbook
rubrics_metrics.description: Newsworthiness criterion: restaurant or chef publishing a cookbook.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cookbooks tied to restaurants create a news hook and can illuminate a restaurant's cuisine and philosophy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Anniversary of a legendary spot
rubrics_metrics.description: Newsworthiness criterion: anniversaries of notable restaurants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Milestone anniversaries provide opportunities for retrospectives or renewed attention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chef prominence
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit newsworthiness: prominence of the chef.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Well-known chefs attract reader interest; prominence can drive enterprise stories beyond a single review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cuisine authenticity / innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit newsworthiness: authenticity or innovation in the cuisine.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stories can focus on how faithfully a cuisine is executed or how it innovates; both angles can be newsworthy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cultural moment alignment
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit newsworthiness: alignment with a broader cultural moment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tie restaurant stories to social, cultural, or political moments to increase relevance for readers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reader-actionable
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit newsworthiness: utility for readers' dining decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize stories and reviews that help readers decide where to eat; include practical details like price, location, reservations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Visual potential
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit newsworthiness: suitability for compelling food photography.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider whether dishes and interiors photograph well, as visual appeal supports reader engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local economic impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit newsworthiness: restaurant's impact on local economy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coverage can address jobs, neighborhood investment, and economic trends tied to openings/closings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industry trend representation
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit newsworthiness: whether the restaurant represents broader industry trends.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use individual restaurants as lenses to explain shifts in the food business (e.g., delivery models, labor practices).

rubrics_metrics.name: Story behind food
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit newsworthiness: human-interest narratives behind dishes (immigrant chef, family heritage).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Profiles and features that surface origin stories enhance cultural context and reader engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustainability angle
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit newsworthiness: sustainability practices and sourcing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlight restaurants prioritizing local sourcing, waste reduction, or other sustainability measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Health / nutrition implications
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit newsworthiness: public health or nutrition angles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider stories that connect restaurant practice to nutrition trends, public health concerns, or ingredient safety.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restaurant industry news
rubrics_metrics.description: Food-beat coverage: closures, openings, ownership changes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report on operational and business developments that affect the dining scene beyond individual reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recipes
rubrics_metrics.description: Food-beat coverage: publishing recipes for readers to reproduce dishes at home.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offer tested recipes and practical cooking guidance as part of the food beat's service to readers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Food trends
rubrics_metrics.description: Food-beat coverage: tracking and explaining current dining and culinary trends.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use reporting to contextualize transient fads versus enduring shifts in taste and business.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agricultural / supply chain
rubrics_metrics.description: Food-beat coverage: stories on agriculture and food supply chains.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investigate upstream issues affecting restaurants, such as ingredient shortages, cost pressures, and producer practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Health / nutrition science
rubrics_metrics.description: Food-beat coverage: reporting on nutrition and food-related health science.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Translate scientific findings accurately and consider implications for consumers and industry actors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Food policy / politics
rubrics_metrics.description: Food-beat coverage: policy, regulation, and political issues affecting food and restaurants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cover legislation, regulatory changes, and political debates that shape the food landscape.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personality profiles (chefs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Food-beat coverage: in-depth profiles of chefs and restaurateurs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide context about influences, training, and career arcs to humanize the industry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cookbook reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Food-beat coverage: evaluating new cookbooks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess recipes, writing quality, originality, and the book's contribution to readers and cooks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclose press meals / comped meals
rubrics_metrics.description: Ethical standard: disclose press meals or comped meals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be transparent in the review about any meals or components that were provided free of charge to avoid misleading readers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclose any chef relationships
rubrics_metrics.description: Ethical standard: disclose personal or professional relationships with chefs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the reviewer has any relationship with the restaurant staff or owners (friendship, past collaboration), disclose it or recuse from reviewing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Don't review friend's restaurant
rubrics_metrics.description: Ethical standard: avoid reviewing restaurants owned or run by friends.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recuse from coverage where personal relationships could bias judgment; maintain independence to preserve credibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Don't accept gifts
rubrics_metrics.description: Ethical standard: do not accept gifts from restaurants or PR representatives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refuse gifts that could influence coverage; disclose any minor tokens if unavoidable and explain why they did not affect the review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinguish reviews from puff pieces
rubrics_metrics.description: Ethical standard: clearly differentiate independent reviews from promotional content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid language or formats that read like publicity; maintain critical distance and label advertorial or sponsored content clearly.
